name: communicate
description: COM8: durable agent identities, native Claude/Codex messaging, shared buses and explicit terminal seats.

interface.shortDescription: Durable identities, agent messaging, buses and terminal seats
interface.longDescription: COM8 combines existing-session Claude/Codex routing, registered buses with a graph and human inbox, persistent identities with saved messages, and explicit tmux seat control. Local operation works without a hosted account. Remote enrollment and terminal control remain separately authorized. Compatible communicate commands and plugin identifiers are retained.
